arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى آدَمَ صِفْوَةِ اللهِ مِنْ خَليقَتِهِ،
english_text: Peace be upon Adam, the chosen one of Allah from among His creation.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى شَيْثٍ وَلِيِّ اللهِ وَ خِيَرَتِهِ،
english_text: Peace be upon Seth (Shaith), the friend of Allah and His elite.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى إدْريسَ الْقائِمِ للهِِ بِحُجَّتِهِ،
english_text: Peace be upon Enoch (Idris), who established (religion) on behalf of Allah by His authority.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى نُوحٍ الْمُجابِ في دَعْوَتِهِ،
english_text: Peace be upon Noah (Nuh), whose invocation (for punishment) was answered.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى هُودٍ الْمَمْدُودِ مِنَ اللهِ بِمَعُونَتِهِ،
transliteration: assalāmu alā hūdinil mamdūdi minal-lāhi bi-maūnatih,
english_text: Peace be upon Hud, who was assisted through Allah’s aid.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى صالِحِ الَّذي تَوَّجَهُ اللهُ بِكَرامَتِهِ،
english_text: Peace be upon Salih, whom Allah crowned with His generosity.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى إبْراهيمَ الَّذي حَباهُ اللهُ بِخُلَّتِهِ،
english_text: Peace be upon Abraham (Ibrahim), whom Allah endowed with His friendship.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى إسْماعيلَ الَّذي فَداهُ اللهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظيمٍ مِنْ جَنَّتِهِ،
transliteration: assalāmu alā 'ismaīlal-ladhī fadāhul-lāhu bi-dhibħin ađīmin min jannatih
english_text: Peace be upon Ishmael (Isma’il), whom Allah ransomed with a great sacrifice from His Heaven.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى إسْحاقَ الَّذي جَعَلَ اللهُ النُّبُوَّةَ في ذُرِّيَّتِهِ،
english_text: Peace be upon Isaac (Is’haq), in whose progeny Allah placed prophethood.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى يَعْقُوبَ الَّذي رَدَّ اللهُ عَلَيْهِ بَصَرَهُ بِرَحْمَتِهِ،
transliteration: assalāmu alā yaqūbal-ladhī raddal-lāhu alayhi bašarahu bi-raħmatih,
english_text: Peace be upon Jacob (Ya’qub), for whom Allah restored his sight by His mercy.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى يُوسُفَ الَّذي نَجّاهُ اللهُ مِنَ الْجُبِّ بِعَظَمَتِهِ،
transliteration: assalāmu alā yūsufal-ladhī najjāhul-lāhu minal jubbi bi-ađamatih,
english_text: Peace be upon Joseph (Yusuf), whom Allah rescued from the well by His majesty.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى مُوسَى الَّذي فَلَقَ اللهُ الْبَحْرَ لَهُ بِقُدْرَتِهِ،
transliteration: assalāmu alā mūsal-ladhī falaqal-lāhul baħra lahu bi-qudratih,
english_text: Peace be upon Moses (Musa), the one for whom Allah split the sea with His Power.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى هارُونَ الَّذي خَصَّهُ اللهُ بِنُبُوَّتِهِ،
english_text: Peace be upon Aaron (Harun), whom Allah distinguished with his prophethood.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى شُعَيْبِ الَّذي نَصَرَهُ اللهُ عَلى اُمَّتِهِ،
english_text: Peace be upon Jethro (Shu’aib), whom Allah made victorious over his people.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى داوُدَ الَّذي تابَ اللهُ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَطيئَتِهِ،
transliteration: assalāmu alā dāwūdal-ladhī tābal-lāhu alayhi min khaţī'atih,
english_text: Peace be upon David (Dawud), to whom Allah turned (in mercy) after his mistake.[1]

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى سُلَيْمانَ الَّذي ذَلَّتْ لَهُ الْجِنُّ بِعِزَّتِهِ،
transliteration: assalāmu alā sulaymānal-ladhīdhallat lahul jinnu bi-izzatih,
english_text: Peace be upon Solomon (Sulaiman), for whom Allah made the Jinn subservient by His majesty.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى أيُّوبَ الَّذي شَفاهُ اللهُ مِنْ عِلَّتِهِ،
english_text: Peace be upon Job (Ayyub), whom Allah cured after his (prolonged) illness.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى يُونُسَ الَّذي أنْجَزَ اللهُ لَهُ مَضْمُونَ عِدَتِهِ،
transliteration: assalāmu alā yūnusal-ladhī 'anjazal-lāhu lahu mađhmūna idatih,
english_text: Peace be upon Jonah (Yunus), for whom Allah fulfilled the purport of His promise.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى عُزَيْرِ الَّذي أحْياهُ اللهُ بَعْدَ ميتَتِهِ،
english_text: Peace be upon Ezra (Uzair), whom Allah brought to life after his death.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى زَكَرِيّا الصّابِرِ في مِحْنَتِهِ،
english_text: Peace be upon Zechariah (Zakariyya), who remained patient in his tribulations.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى يَحْيَى الَّذي أزْلَفَهُ اللهُ بِشَهادَتِهِ،
english_text: Peace be upon John (Yahya), whom Allah drew near (his rank) by his martyrdom.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى عيسى رُوحِ اللهِ وَ كَلِمَتِهِ،
english_text: Peace be upon Jesus (Isa), the spirit of Allah and His word.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ حَبيبِ اللهِ وَ صِفْوَتِهِ،
transliteration: assalāmu alā muħammaddin ħabībil-lāhi wa šifwatih,
english_text: Peace be upon Muhammad, the beloved of Allah and His elite.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى أميرِالْمُؤْمِنينَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أبي طالِبٍ الْمَخْصُوصِ بِاُخُوَّتِهِ،
transliteration: assalāmu alā 'amīril mu'minīna aliyy-ibni 'abī ţālibinil-makhšūši bi-'ukhuwwatih,
english_text: Peace be upon the Leader of the Faithful, Ali Ibn Abi Talib, who was exclusively selected for brotherhood to him (the Prophet (PBUH&HF)).

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى فاطِمَةَ الزَّهْراءِ ابْنَتِهِ،
english_text: Peace be upon Fatima al-Zahra, his daughter.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى أبي مُحَمَّدٍ الْحَسَنِ وَصِيِّ أبيهِ وَ خَليفَتِهِ،
transliteration: assalāmu alā 'abi muħammadinil-ħasani wašiyyi 'abīhi wa khalīfatih,
english_text: Peace be upon Abu Muhammad al-Hasan, the executor of (the will of) his father, and his successor.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلَى الْحُسَيْنِ الَّذي سَمَحَتْ نَفْسُهُ بِمُهْجَتِهِ،
english_text: Peace be upon al-Husain, who sacrificed himself up to the last drops of the blood of his heart.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى مَنْ أطاعَ اللهَ في سِرِّهِ وَ عَلانِيَتِهِ،
transliteration: assalāmu alā man 'aţāal-lāha fī sirrihi wa alāniyatih,
english_text: Peace be upon him, who obeyed Allah secretly and openly.

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى مَنْ جَعَلَ اللهُ الشِّفاءَ في تُرْبَتِهِ،
transliteration: assalāmu alā man jaalal-lāhush-shifā'a fī turbatih,
english_text: Peace be upon whom Allah placed a cure in the soil of his place (of martyrdom).

arabic_text: اَلسَّلامُ عَلى مَنِ الإجابَةُ تَحْتَ قُبَّتِهِ،
english_text: Peace be upon the one under whose dome answer (to supplications) is guaranteed.
